title: Pick6

record.label: Logged standard slips only (sizes 3/4/6/8 under both rankings, all markets on, last pre-tip board). Custom builds in the browser are not logged or graded.
record.return_label: multiplier product returned = the sum, over fully-hit slips, of their multiplier product at a flat 1 unit per slip. A Standings Points basis, not a payout.
record.base_payout_label: Base Payout returned = the sum of DraftKings' guaranteed Base Payout multiples of the graded slips at 1 unit each, by the published formula (data/pick6_rules.md). Extra Winnings from the prize pool are not included: they depend on the other winners.
record.void_rule: A void leg drops the slip a level: it is graded on its non-void legs (reduced). A slip left with 0 or 1 non-void legs is a refund, counted separately.

payout_note: Pick6 is a prize pool: winners share it in proportion to Standings Points. The multiplier product shown here is a Standings Points basis, not a payout and not a price. See data/pick6_rules.md for what is and is not published about payouts.

payout.source: DraftKings support article KB0010250 'Picks with Multipliers and Standings Points' (v13, 2026-08-25) and the Pick6 page's own entry details for the pick group; see data/pick6_rules.md
payout.base_multiplier: Base Multiplier = Standard Base Multiplier of the sport and pick tier x the Pick Multiplier of all the picks in the lineup, capped at a Max Base Multiplier
payout.standings_points: Standings Points = entry fee x the Pick Multipliers of the correct picks; a winner's share of the prize pool is its Standings Points over all winners' Standings Points
payout.label: Base Payout multiple (DraftKings' guaranteed minimum per $1 if every leg hits; Extra Winnings from the prize pool come on top and cannot be known in advance)
payout.partial_tier_reading: for a tier with a missed pick (5 of 6, 7 of 8, ...) the article's wording 'all the picks in your lineup' is applied literally; its worked example covers only an all-correct lineup

label: The model's first-3-minutes leaders matched to tonight's Pick6 board. Historical rates only: no prices, no edges, no win probabilities. This method is not priced or backtested.

rules.firsts: leaders ranked on tonight's team only (count; per-start rate when the best current-team count is under 3); career is context
rules.window: More only, default line; share of starts clearing tonight's line; current team when n >= 15 else career; minimum n = 20
rules.caps: max 1 leg per player, max 2 legs per game; game-level markets one leg per game, team-level markets one leg per team
readings: per-start-rate ranking needs at least 5 starts with tonight's team
legs ordered count-ranked units first, then rate-ranked units
a current-team window sample of 15-19 starts is not a candidate (basis by the first rule, under the minimum of 20)
